_about: Suggested AtmospherePreset values for the Dawn Guild hub (Blender/town/guild.py). Field names match Assets/_Game/Scripts/Runtime/World/Atmosphere.cs (AtmospherePreset). Colours are Unity Color [r,g,b,a] in 0..1; vectors are [x,y,z] Euler degrees. Not applied automatically: copy the values into the 'town_dawn' / 'town_night' cases of AtmospherePreset.ForTileset.

town_dawn._use: Daytime guild (TownWorld.Initialize with title=false). Bright sunrise light through the glass front.

town_night._use: Evening title shot (TownWorld.Initialize with title=true). Screens, the gate and the lamps carry the glow.
